name: Chicken Roll Paratha
description: Juicy spiced chicken strips wrapped in a soft, buttery paratha. A classic street-style roll that hits every time.

name: Chicken Cheese Roll Paratha
description: Our classic chicken paratha roll taken up a notch with a generous layer of melted cheese inside.

name: Zinger Roll
description: A crispy fried zinger chicken fillet rolled up with fresh veggies and house sauce in a soft wrap.

name: Zinger Roll Cheese
description: The Zinger Roll upgraded with melted cheese — extra rich, extra satisfying.

name: Chicken Shawarma
description: Classic Islamabad-style chicken shawarma with garlic sauce, fresh veggies, and soft bread. A local favourite.

name: Chicken Special Shawarma
description: Our premium shawarma with extra fillings, special house sauce, and more chicken than the regular version.

name: Chicken Nuggets
description: 6 golden, crispy-fried chicken nuggets with a tender juicy inside. Perfect for sharing or snacking.

name: Chicken Wings
description: 6 pieces of well-seasoned, crispy fried chicken wings. Great with any dipping sauce.

name: Chicken Bites
description: 6 pieces of bite-sized crispy fried chicken chunks. Light, easy to eat, and full of flavour.

name: French Fries
description: Classic golden crispy fries, lightly salted and served hot. A crowd-pleaser with any meal.

name: Cheese Fries
description: Hot crispy fries smothered in rich melted cheese sauce. Indulgent and absolutely worth it.

name: Masala Fries
description: Crispy fries tossed in a bold desi masala blend — spicy, tangy, and completely addictive.

name: Mayo Garlic Fries

description: Creamy, garlicky dipping sauce. Goes perfectly with fries, rolls, and wraps.

name: Mint Garlic Sauce

name: Peri Peri Sauce
description: Bold, fiery peri peri sauce with layers of heat and smokiness. For the spice lovers.

name: Special Sauce
description: Our signature house blend — tangy, creamy, and slightly spiced. Works with everything on the menu.

name: Bar BQ Sauce
description: Smoky, sweet, and tangy BBQ dipping sauce. Pairs best with wings, nuggets, and bites.

name: Thousand Island
description: Classic sweet and tangy Thousand Island dressing — great as a dip or drizzled over fries.

name: Sweet Lassi

name: Strawberry Lassi

name: Mango Lassi

name: Sweet Lassi with Badam

name: Chocolate Brownie 2 Scoops
